text:
Alex (People Ops): Quick org update — Dana is stepping into VP of Platform effective May 2. Priya Rao will be Acting Director, Inference Platform while we run a search for the permanent hire.
Dana Kline: Thanks team — excited for Priya, she'll own roadmap and hiring until we fill the role. Please direct hiring questions to Kim.
Priya Rao: honored! I'll be setting up weekly 1:1 office hours for the team next week. Happy to chat about priorities.
Mike Chen: congrats Priya! Any changes to the Eng lead reporting structure?
Alex (People Ops): No immediate org shifts — reporting stays the same for now. We're approving +2 headcount for Sr Staff/Principal Eng to support model serving and runtime. Req numbers and job descriptions to follow.
Kim (Talent): Heads up — I'll post JD drafts today. Plan: 2-stage loop: take-home + 4 interviews (system design, runtime perf, product sense, team fit).
Sarah Lopez: Will these roles be remote-friendly / hybrid?
Kim (Talent): Yes — remote in US or CA. Relocation stipend if they move to SF/NY for Dedicated seat owners.
recruiter-bot: New reqs created: REQ-2309, REQ-2310. Links: https://recruiting.example/REQ-2309
Dana Kline: timeline: hire window 6–10 weeks. We'll prioritize internal transfers first.
Mike Chen: who is the hiring manager on these reqs?
Alex (People Ops): Priya will be hiring manager for one role; Mike will co-hire for the second (runtime infra focus).
Priya Rao: will coordinate interviewers. Please ping me if you'd like to be on the loop — prefer folks who've worked on batching/kv cache.
Sarah Lopez: congrats again Dana + Priya :tada:
Kim (Talent): I'll kick off outreach this afternoon. Expect an interview packet in #eng-ops by EOD.
Alex (People Ops): Thanks — we'll post an internal announcement and update the org chart. LMK if anything should be redacted for public hiring pages.
Dana Kline: appreciate the team moving fast. Open to feedback — DM me or Alex.
